title: Vect Nokru
description: The Third Sister conspired to draw Obi-Wan Kenobi out in the open by having Princess Leia Organa kidnapped. She hired mercenary Vect Nokru to do it. Norku took Leia to Daiyu to lure Kenobi into a trap. However, Kenobi escaped with Leia. The Grand Inquisitor angrily questioned Norku. The questioning swiftly turned into the mercenary's execution.
